entities.description: A full-body shot of a dark-skinned man walking forward on a sandy surface, wearing traditional African attire including a beaded headband with a single feather, a multi-layered red and white beaded necklace, and a patterned wrap skirt with fringes. He is bare-chested and barefoot, with white wrappings around his ankles, and has a neutral expression.

entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing African man with dark skin, wearing traditional attire including a red and white beaded necklace, a red and white patterned wrap skirt with fringe, and a headband with feathers. He holds a wooden staff in his right hand and has his left hand on his hip, standing on sandy ground in front of a mud wall.
